name: read_md_section.py
purpose: Print one Markdown section without reading the whole file
usage: python3 read_md_section.py FILE#anchor | python3 read_md_section.py FILE "Heading text"
summary: Read FILE lines; find headings outside code fences (``` or ~~~); anchor = GitHub slug (lower-case, drop chars other than word,-,space; spaces to -; repeated slugs get -1,-2); match anchor or exact heading text; print from that heading up to the next heading of same or higher level (subsections included); exit 0. Not found: print available anchors to stderr, exit 1. Bad arguments: exit 2.

name: agent_md_check.py
purpose: Audit an agent instruction file for stale references, duplicated rules and size
requires: python3 stdlib only; read_md_section.py in the same directory; git optional
summary: Strip code fences. Collect Markdown link targets and backticked path-like tokens (only [\w./-] with a known file extension or trailing /). Skip URLs. For each: print 'STALE <ref>: path not found' if neither the path (relative to FILE) nor any 'git ls-files' entry matches (bare names may sit in subdirectories); print 'STALE <ref>: no such section' if the #anchor is not a heading of the target .md. For each line of 40+ chars of FILE that appears (whitespace and case normalised) in another .md file print 'DUP     in <file>: <first 70 chars>'. Last line: 'SIZE    <file>: <lines> lines, <bytes> bytes, ~<bytes/4> tokens'. Exit 1 if any STALE, else 0.

name: completion_to_md.py
purpose: Turn a Prompter completion record (JSON, with its Mermaid chart) into one Markdown document
summary: Read COMPLETION.json; its "format" must be "prompter-completion". Print (or write to --out) a Markdown document: title and date, the Mermaid chart in a fenced block when ROADMAP.mmd is given, then one section per thread (folder, branch, worktree, start) and one subsection per prompt (status, summary, proof, pitfalls, commits, files, notes), skipping empty fields. Not a record or unreadable file: message on stderr, exit 1. Bad arguments: exit 2.
